pages.text: Compared to those weak cannon fodder, there are always some servants you are unwilling to lose — you want them to serve you better.$(br)So you came up with a new idea: extract their souls, seal their bodies into the monument, and with the help of versatile and efficient dark magic, you now have servants that are always on call and never truly die.$(br)After placing the monument, use a $(l:goety:crafts/taglock_kit)Taglock Kit$(/l) to bind a servant, then right-click the monument with the kit to enter the binding ritual.$(br)Once in the ritual, you must kill a villager within 10 blocks of the monument — they will die in the servant's place. After the villager dies, the servant will vanish and the ritual is complete.

Note: you cannot leave the ritual once it has started — you can only exit by breaking the monument or waiting for the ritual to time out.$(br)Monument servants cannot be unbound once bound. The only way to clear all servants from the monument is to shift + left-click the monument three times with an empty hand. Bind carefully.$(br)Monument servants can be summoned from any dimension. Each servant costs 1000 soul energy.$(br)Upgrading the monument increases capacity by 4 per tier, while reducing soul consumption like the $(l:goetymech_machines/squad_barracks)Squad Barracks$(/l).$(br)$(4)"Why are these elites so easy to kill? Damn it, I'm sick of wasting so much time reviving them every time. I need a more efficient way to make them serve me!"$()
